description: This file defines the 'VoiceControl' class, which implements a plugin for voice control functionality within the WPEFramework. It declares methods for handling voice commands, session management, and event processing, as well as internal utility functions and IARM (Inter-Application Resource Management) integration.

classes.description: The main plugin class managing voice control operations, events, and interactions within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.
